name: Facet
text: Ship EXCAVA with a dark theme by default but auto-switch to light mode when the system detects high ambient light. This keeps the interface visible in bright environments without forcing users to manually adjust, while the dark theme preserves the competitive edge of Manus’ analysis and Graphify’s graph-focused design. Trade-off: some users may prefer a consistent dark mode, but the auto-switch balances readability and brand consistency better than a static theme.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t ambient light—it’s that auto-switching still assumes users *want* their interface to change without their input. A better alternative is a persistent dark theme with a high-contrast toggle, giving users control while keeping the competitive edge. Settle it with user testing: measure task completion time and preference between auto-switching and manual toggle in varying light conditions.
